caption: Panting against a closed shutter gives a tiny box-pressure swing and a larger mouth-pressure swing. Their ratio, scaled by the 600 L box, gives thoracic gas volume 3.0 L and residual volume 1.8 L.

spec.title: Plethysmograph measurement
spec.aria: A subject in a sealed 600 L box pants against a closed shutter; box pressure 0.05 cm H2O and mouth pressure 10 cm H2O give thoracic gas volume 3.0 L, and subtracting expiratory reserve volume 1.2 L gives residual volume 1.8 L.
